vbs-stage.note: wscript or cscript running the group's VBS. How this script arrived is not described.

decoy-comment.note: The comment is inert and is meant to make an LLM code scanner refuse. ESET did not test a product. A refusal on a malware sample should start a review.

loader.note: If the script runs, it still downloads MATCHBOIL. The comment does not change that behavior.

scanner-gap.note: DugganUSA's one-day test is independent of ESET and used a synthetic script. One refusal is not a measurement of this incident file.
